items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He used to call me Dodie, a nickname.

ctx.x: say that now, but we can't do him nothin' now. But everybody did a little legging. Now, remember, this was during Prohibition. And Buddy would come around there, and bring his horn -- and like I said, that was Papa's soft spot. Hey there, Mister Henry, how are them boys of yours comin' along?" You know, Buddy and Papa. "You got some boys there that's fine musicians. That Dodie..." He used to call me Dodie, a nickname. "That Dodie gonna be a good clarinet-man, a good stick-man," and he said "That boy on violin..."…
